## Scientific and behavioral consistency — PASS

The engineering view introduces no scientific rule absent from the scientist-facing explanation and its explicitly admitted inherited authority. Both entrypoints use one transparent `common_core.tex` wrapper and the same six modules. The view flag adds formal tables, binding identities, worked cases, requirements and evidence mapping to the engineering view. It does not substitute competing definitions or equations.

The following agreements were checked across PDF text, common source, crosswalks and proposed/approved decision records:

- Exact dimensionless raw and normalized unity applies only to the finite, nonempty, identity-unique exact output support of a completed PTC publication. A singleton is valid; empty support has no instance; outside-support absence is distinct from zero. There is no configurable constant, family default, publication-size default, or inferred fallback.
- Authoritative target `R_q` and independently checked stored `R-hat_g` have different roles. Exact source/generation/scope/digest equality permits compact association without a copied list. Enumerated `M_g` must contain every and only each exact target identity once. Count, order or shape cannot repair mismatch.
- Scalar, unit, integrity and membership are independent T/F/U/C facts. Any independent F makes UQ-05 F; otherwise C is retained before U, and only all T yields T. A contradiction about one fact remains one C; its negative branch is not separately counted as F. All causes remain available. The ten mixed cases and sixteen predictions agree with this rule.
- A named-profile request is independent of selected-family truth, so a known different family reaches UQ-01 F. No request creates no evaluation. Request, applicability, eligibility and evaluation-artifact realization remain separate; a completed negative or unresolved evaluation can be successfully realized.
- A malformed attempted reference remains local. A corrupt/misbound shared authoritative identity or binding record prevents establishment for its references. Once payload publication identity/binding is valid, corrupt, digest-failing or decoder-invalid bound bytes remain `Q_integrity` F; unavailable/unexplained integrity evidence is U and same-fact contradiction is C. This partition agrees in engineering §§3.2–3.4/8.2, science §2.1, REQ-017, MIX-008, PRED-009 and the proposed records.
- Permission denial is consumer-specific ineligibility, never payload corruption. Missing/conflicting permission is unresolved absent another decisive false. MAP and JINC retain independent permission and numerical/admission gates. All restrictions and structural invariants are nonexceptionable.
- Each `q` is a separately complete segment, scan, or bounded within-segment/scan chunk. Required components and links must be durable before completion, preserving inherited PTC REQ-072. Unrelated publications or observation completion do not gate handoff. Exact shared facts may be evaluated once and referenced without mandatory per-occurrence coefficient or full profile storage. Mean-one is an analytic identity and requires no literal reduction of stored ones.
- Positive-rank statements are confined to the admitted first ordinary PTC route and explicitly cite frozen PTC REQ-090/094/095. Rank zero, noninteger or unrealizable positive rank fails closed with cause; it creates no alternate route. PTC-disabled remains separately RTC-terminal. The coefficient package supplies no identity/zero-rank route authority.
- Changed family/profile/permission/boundary rules require corresponding versioned successors; changed actual supports/products under unchanged rules create new immutable realizations. Earlier records remain intact. UQ-07 checks pre-existing lineage and write-once construction before sealing; finalization then records realization. A finalization failure cannot invent a completed UQ-07 result or eligibility assertion.
- `a` identifies application generation, `q` PTC publication and `g` coefficient realization; `i` is detector-time occurrence and `p` is consumer spatial index. Equations retain JINC ownership of signed `kappa_ip` and NOI ownership of derived MAP balance.
- Fixed unity adds no coefficient sampling uncertainty and does not assign zero to physical, response, covariance, selection, representation or performance uncertainty. NOI still needs the exact lossless rational parent bound to the complete MAP/coefficient generations. No NOI profile grant, JINC-hosted NOI route, design-law change or performance/readiness claim is created.
